changes: Two licensed face photographs warped by 468 source-bound landmarks, blended by surface viewing angle, and baked into the fitted animated skin UVs; eye/glasses region excluded and closed-mouth reference prioritized. Gray hair and brown iris colors authored.
limitations: Photographic illumination, glasses and occlusions can remain baked into the surface.
The photograph bake is not intrinsic albedo or photogrammetric reconstruction.
The two texture views share one event family; other event families contribute geometry only.
Likeness and animation quality require explicit visual review.
